title: Epoch audit of campaign target positions
summary: The TOI-table target positions in the campaign specs were labelled J2000.0 but are at the Gaia DR2 epoch J2015.5 for 77 of 78 targets (TOI-6663.01 carries a Gaia DR1 position, J2015.0); none is at J2000.0. Verified against Gaia DR3 propagated positions and direct DR2/DR1 matches; labels corrected in specs, scaffolds and runners.
